validation_scope: All P4 icon/footprint/shadow images decode at original dimensions. Actual PokemonIconSprite crop/HP timing/selection anchor/full cell cycles and ItemIconSprite center-origin paths use explicit source overrides on one baseline species/item; this is not proof of every species or item binding. Five current shadow assets use the real shadow compositor. Legacy numeric footprints and non-icon egg/bag assets are unchanged static compatibility sources, not claimed as animated or mapped to current named resolver paths. Egg crack sequencing is deferred to the animation audit.
byte_identity_guarantee: All retained game images, backups and deliveries are byte-identical; no frame, alpha, timing or image content changes.
